gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 1,051.0m at 1 January 2020. During 2020 the Syndicate recorded favourable prior year development of GBP 6.6m primarily due to reductions in loss estimates for the 2017-2019 weather-related large loss events. Offsetting this, 2020 incurred significant weather-related large losses (including Hurricane Laura and Hurricane Sally) and loss estimates for the Coronavirus pandemic which together contributed to an GBP 88.6m impact in 2020. The Syndicate also purchased an Adverse Development Cover protecting casualty years (2017 and prior) in 2020, which materially increased reinsurers' share of claims outstanding (~GBP 243.7m) and thereby reduced net retained reserves.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the GBP 6.6m prior-year favourable development are explicitly stated in the report (high confidence). The report does not disaggregate the GBP 6.6m by line of business. The Adverse Development Cover purchase effect is inferred from the increase in reinsurers' share of claims outstanding (explicit balances given), and the net impact on member reserves is inferred as a release; this mapping is high confidence for the reinsurers' share amount but lower for the exact net reserve impact by LOB. Named-event losses are mentioned in aggregate (e.g. combined GBP 88.6m impact for 2020 weather events and COVID estimates) and are not fully allocated to individual named events, so per-event loss amounts are not quantified in the source and are reported as null where not explicit.
